QuestInfo.name: [MapleStory X Evangelion] Eva Repair Support!
QuestInfo.0: They're having some trouble repairing the Eva... You should talk to Dr. Kim to see what you can do.
QuestInfo.1: It seems you can find parts by hunting Monsters Near Your Level. If you want to do the job right, you'll need 40 #b#i3996152# #t3996152##k items!
QuestInfo.2: You found all the parts you could for the Eva repairs, but there were only enough to last the day. You'll have to come back again tomorrow to be able to continue your efforts.

default.0: You don't have enough parts yet! You'll have to keep searching.
